definitions.explanation: A strong desire to know or learn about something.

examples.japanese: {好奇心|こうきしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{好奇心|こうきしん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{好奇心|こうきしん}⟦{旺盛|おうせい}→旺盛：09331_ousei⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧。

notes:
{好奇心|こうきしん} refers to a strong desire to learn or know about things. Usually positive, describing intellectual or exploratory interest, but can also imply nosy or meddlesome curiosity depending on context.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {好奇心|こうきしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: very curious
- {好奇心|こうきしん}⟦{旺盛|おうせい}→旺盛：09331_ousei⟧: brimming with curiosity
- {好奇心|こうきしん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: out of curiosity
- {好奇心|こうきしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たす→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧: to satisfy one's curiosity
- {好奇心|こうきしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦そそる→そそる：10359_sosoru⟧: to arouse curiosity

WRITING:
{好|こう} (like) + {奇|き} (strange/unusual) + {心|しん} (heart/mind) — literally 'a heart that likes the unusual.'

PROVERB:
{好奇心|こうきしん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{殺|ころ}す→殺す：01944_korosu⟧ (Curiosity killed the cat).
